title: Cartwise+ Membership Activity Credit for Recent Benefit Use
content:
An activity credit is taken off the move-to-monthly charge for Cartwise+ Membership members who shopped with their benefits in the last month, when the membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request.

| Member fee waivers on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders in the last month | Activity credit taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.50 |
| exactly one | 0.25 |
| none | 0.00 |

## How the waivers are counted

- A member fee waiver is a fee-waiver entry on one of the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders; each entry counts once.
- The last month is counted in whole months ending today; a waiver dated on the same day of the month one month back is not counted. With today 18 August, waivers dated 19 July through 18 August count, and one dated 18 July does not.

## Hypothetical cases

| Waivers in the window | Activity credit |
|---|---|
| a delivery-fee waiver on one order and a service-fee waiver on another | 0.50 |
| one delivery-fee waiver | 0.25 |
| one waiver dated exactly one month back, none since | 0.00 |
